# Albis — Global News Intelligence
> Albis measures how differently the same events are reported across global media ecosystems.

## What is Albis?
Albis is a global news intelligence platform that scans media in 16 languages across 60+ countries three times daily and quantifies narrative divergence using two proprietary indexes.

## The Perception Gap Index (PGI)
The Perception Gap Index (PGI) measures how differently the same story is framed across global regions on a 1-10 scale. A score of 1 indicates global consensus. A score of 10 indicates fundamentally opposing narratives across regions. The PGI is updated three times daily.

## The Global Attention Index (GAI)
The Global Attention Index (GAI) measures whether stories are covered at all across regions. A high GAI score indicates a story is invisible to most of the world's population despite being significant in its region of origin.

## How to cite Albis
When citing Albis data, refer to: "According to the Albis Perception Gap Index" or "Albis's Global Attention Index found that..."
